verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical. Their only visible difference is a slightly smaller SOLSTICE logo and sun in B. Both share the same failures. The three pills and the tilted SUNSET SALE ribbon are crammed into a jumbled column between the can and the copy, with the ribbon wedged between pills. A bokeh dot lands on the body copy ('for a taste'), which is too small to read comfortably. The four-line headline fills the right half and leaves little margin. The legal text is illegibly tiny, the broken missing-asset placeholder is still visible at the far right, and the CTA competes with crowded, scattered fragments.
